crossRefs.note: “This is the land that still remains: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;
all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out…
Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”
Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Yahweh. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to…

people.name: Great_Sea
people.line: The Mediterranean Sea, the western boundary of the Promised Land.

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.
translations.bsb: See, I have allotted as an inheritance to your tribes these remaining nations, including all the nations I have already cut off, from the Jordan westward to the Great Sea.
translations.kjv: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.
translations.asv: Behold, I have allotted unto you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun.
